Variants.Content: Military discipline stipulates when to march, when to take food, who can leave the team, and how to treat prisoners and civilians. Strict military discipline can make an army last, but cruel military discipline may just create obedience; soldiers know best whether the rules are fair, because punishment usually falls on them first

Entry Military Discipline Military discipline stipulates when to march, when to take food, who can leave the team, and how to treat prisoners and civilians. Strict military discipline can make an army last, but cruel military discipline may just create obedience; soldiers know best whether the rules are fair, because punishment usually falls on them first Victory or defeat on the battlefield is important, but who can keep the army with horse supplies and silver coins in the second month often determines the length of the war.
